title: User sign-up with email and password
description: As a new user, I want to create an account with email and password, so that I can access the application.
acceptance_criteria: Sign-up form validates email format and password strength.
Verification email is sent within 30 seconds of submission.
Duplicate email addresses are rejected with a clear error message.

title: User login with email and password
description: As a registered user, I want to log in with my email and password, so that I can access my account.
acceptance_criteria: Successful login redirects to the home feed within 2 seconds.
Failed login shows a generic error (no hint about which field is wrong).
Account is locked after 5 consecutive failed attempts.

title: Password reset via email
description: As a user who has forgotten their password, I want to reset it via email, so that I can regain access to my account.
acceptance_criteria: User is redirected to login after a successful password change.
